description: This source file is the code-behind for an ASP.NET WebForms page named EditMCQ, which handles various UI interactions like course selection, navigation buttons, and session management within an online examination system.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the EditMCQ ASP.NET page, handling UI events and course selection logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminPanel.aspx page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminQueue.aspx page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the AdminLeaderboard.aspx page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester, using hardcoded course lists.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores the selected course in session variable '_CRS1'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers control to the LoginPage.aspx to log out the user.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester.
